notes.title: Release Date Anouncement
notes.notes: [p]Greetings from [b]Blackreef[/b],[/p][p]Since the demo stage, we’ve been working hard to improve the game with your feedback. Along the way, we’ve added new locations, new ships, more characters, and different mechanics. We’ll be sharing all of these additions and the changes we’ve made in more detail soon in Devlog 2, but for now, we wanted to announce the release date of our game.[/p][p]Once again, we sincerely thank everyone who has supported us, shown interest in our game, and provided feedback throughout this journey.[/p][p][/p][p]See you soon.[/p][p]Two Nomads Studio[/p][previewyoutube="ZzNKJqxjRMM;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]First of all, huge thanks to everyone who played our demo and shared their valuable feedback. We're doing our best to fix any issues as quickly as possible during development. Big thanks as well to those who reached out via the in-game [i]Bug Report[/i] system or through our Discord server — your support really helps us improve! [/p][p]Based on the feedback so far, we’ve made several updates:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed font issues in some languages[/p][/*][*][p]Made character movement smoother[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where faxes wouldn't arrive[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved collider and dirt-related bugs on ships[/p][/*][/list][p]In addition to that, we’ve also addressed a few other bugs and missing elements we noticed ourselves, and pushed out some quick updates.[/p][p]If you come across any issues moving forward, feel free to reach out via the in-game bug report feature or our Discord server.[/p][p]Once again, thank you so much to everyone who tried the demo and took the time to share their thoughts. Your support means a lot during this development journey! [/p]
